name: Indian Butter Chicken with Spinach & Rice (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup basmati rice
water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and tender, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a medium bowl and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
butter, unsalted
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the onions are cooking, pat chicken dry with paper towels, then cut into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g chicken thighs, boneless skinless
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the onion is done, return skillet to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
½ small bunch cilantro
½ pint grape tomatoes
½ English cucumber
½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the cooked onion.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, along with tomato paste, water, garam masala, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the spice paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp tomato paste
2 tbsp water
2 tsp garam masala
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer 1 cup of the cooked chicken to a plate and set aside. Return skillet to medium-high heat, add spice paste, and stir to coat remaining chicken. Add broth and cream, then stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until butter chicken has thickened, 10-12 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups chicken or vegetable broth
¼ cup heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve grape tomatoes. Add to the plate with the plain chicken.
Trim and slice cucumber crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the plate and set aside.
When the curry has thickened, add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Stir to combine and remove from heat.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 1 cup of rice, plain chicken, and veggies between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining rice and butter chicken between bowls. Enjoy!
